about: For each aerial survey read by web/tree-imagery.js: the files of LINZ's sheet grid it holds (per sheet, bit (row - 1) * columns + (column - 1), least significant first, base64) and its capture area (NZTM2000, grown by 20 m and simplified to 10 m; rings of whole metres, x0, y0, dx1, dy1, ...); and the scanned historical surveys of Auckland, oldest first. From the STAC catalogue of the LINZ imagery archive (CC BY 4.0). Built by pipeline/tool/build_imagery_coverage.py.
